document.name: ConvertersDataTables
document.documentation: Non-persistent Kitchen Sink fixture that lists the converters fixtures in a PrimeFaces data table for each group of converters (each list grid's componentBuilderClass is faces), for filters typed as the cells show the values. The list views of the same queries are the Vue list grids (PrimeFaces) and SmartClient's.
